verdict.rationale: LobeHub's llms.txt explicitly claims 'Each agent has persistent memory, editable by you, allowing humans and agents to co-evolve over time,' which directly supports durable cross-session memory. However this is a single terse marketing-style claim with no detail on automatic write/recall behavior, no dedicated docs page walking through the feature, and no independent or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation explaining automatic memory writing/recall mechanics, examples of memory persisting across sessions, and independent/community verification that it works as described.
